chunks.title: [Cantonese Subtitled Dubbing] CLO Official Tutorial Video ~ Error Correction Part p04 4. Adjusting the Unstable Simulation of Buttons
chunks.content: ## Opening and Locating the Practice File for Power Button Simulation This section explains how to access the PRACTICE FILE named "d.corrected" within the PowerButtonSimulation folder under EFIXES, which is essential for correcting errors in the button simulation. - In the sketch window, double-click to open the **PRACTICE FILE** folder. - Locate the file named **d.corrected** inside the **PowerButtonSimulation** directory within **EFIXES**. - Open the **d.corrected** file for further adjustments. ## Identifying and Correcting Distorted Arrangement Before Simulation This section covers how to identify distortion caused by incorrect file arrangement before running the simulation and introduces tools for adjusting layer relationships and positions. - The PRACTICE FILE appears distorted due to improper arrangement before simulation. - Select the PRACTICE FILE in the 2D window. - Right-click on the PRACTICE FILE and choose **2D arrangement position** from the context menu. - Use the positioning tool available in the 3D window to rearrange the layer relationships properly. - Open the arrangement point of the PRACTICE FILE to make precise adjustments. ## Adjusting Door Panel Positions for Stable Simulation This section details the procedure for selecting and adjusting the left and right door panels simultaneously to correct unstable simulation behavior. - In the 2D window, select both the left and right door panels at the same time. - Click on the PRACTICE FILE at the pre-arrangement point to begin adjustment. - Lower the door panels to their correct positions. - Activate the simulation to test the adjustments. - Verify the shape and behavior after adjustment to ensure stability. ## Summary By properly locating the PRACTICE FILE, identifying distortion issues caused by incorrect arrangement, and using the 2D and 3D positioning tools to rearrange layers and door panels, the unstable simulation of buttons can be corrected effectively. This workflow ensures accurate simulation results for the PowerButtonSimulation project within CLO.
